tenderSchedule.title: PROCUREMENT OF IT EQUIPMENT AND LICENSES DURING THE YEAR 2025-26
tenderSchedule.description: Supply & Installation of All-in-one-Desktop Computers and Server, with five years Comprehensive Warranty, Multifunction Laser Jet and Inktank A4 Monochrome Printers, Multifunction Laserjet and Inktank & A3 Color Printers with three years Comprehensive Warranty, and Supply of Microsoft Office 2025 Standard Perpetual Licenses, Microsoft Windows Server 2025 Standard edition perpetual license and MS SQL Server Standard Licenses.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KFD DCF HQ Aranya Bhavan Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the proposed products or the authorized supplier of the OEM

Annual financial average turnover during the last 3 year ending 31st March of previous year (FY 2023- 24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 should be as per tender document. Audited balance sheet and IT returns for the last three financial years to be submitted
Bidder should have relevant quality certification of ISO 9001:2008/2015 for process quality which shall have binding impact on evaluation criteria
The production facility of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) should have ISO 27001 or latest
The production facility of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) should have ISO 14001 or latest
Bidder should have positive net worth as on 31-03-2026, duly certified by CA (Chartered accountant

The Bidder should not be under a Declaration of Ineligibility for corrupt or fraudulent practices or blacklisted by any of the Government agencies. Declaration should be given by authorized signatory as per Appendix-K of tender document

The Bidder should have statutory registrations such as company incorporation certificates from RoC, valid PAN, GST registration etc. In case the bidder is a partnership/proprietary ship firm, then relevant firm incorporation certificate is to be submitted
The Bidder should have a registered company in India.

The bidder & OEM should comply with Government Order No. FD 455 EXP-12-2020, Bengaluru dated: 25-08-2020. (Refer Annexure-2 of the said order) and its amendments if any. Signed copy of the declaration as per annexure-2 of the said order should be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Purchase Order copies shall be submitted as proof of having similar experience
